latHint: Think a short rest in the middle of work - not a snap.
pivHint: A karate student can BREAK a board - but a coffee BREAK is a short ______ from work.
winText: Coffee time. BREAK was the pivot - a snap to a PAUSE.
lossText: PAUSE - a short stop. BREAK was the pivot: BREAKing a board to a coffee BREAK.
